name: T3 Code
author: pingdotgg
login: No account sign-in — the tailnet is the boundary. Open the URL in a browser on the tailnet; the first visit pairs that browser.

To pair another device, run on the box: `~/.local/share/t3code/bin/t3 pair --base-dir ~/services/t3code --tailscale --tailscale-serve-port 8109` — `--tailscale` makes the link tailnet-reachable (set the port to HTTPS_PORT if you changed it); the QR/link lasts 5 minutes.
description: T3 Code (t3.codes): the web control surface for coding agents — steer Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and friends running on this box from any tailnet browser. Upstream's self-contained `t3 serve` bundle under ~/.local/share/t3code, loopback-only behind Serve on :8109, state in ~/services/t3code. setup.sh tracks the newest GitHub release by default (T3_VERSION pins one).
